title: Temperature and salinity of each ocean profile around Antarctica at standard depths (OCEAN ICE profile compilation)
product_version: Southern Ocean (90S-45S) conservative temperature and absolute salinity profiles compilation (OCEAN ICE D1.1), 1970-2025 (published August 2026)
reference: Zhou, S., Dutrieux, P., Giulivi, C., Lee, W. S., Kim, T.-W., Hattermann, T. and Janout, M. (2026). Southern Ocean (90S-45S) conservative temperature and absolute salinity profiles compilation (OCEAN ICE D1.1). SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/99787

curves.layout: for each point in the points package's order: the values at the standard depths shallower than its max_depth, then the value at max_depth; a curve's length follows from max_depth, so curves need no offsets
curves.search: a standard depth takes the nearest 10 m bin with data within 20 m (fill where none)

fields.name: ct
fields.note: Conservative Temperature along each curve, curves concatenated in point order

fields.name: sa
fields.note: Absolute Salinity along each curve, in the same order
